benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: The IndiGo First Dual Credit Card Against FD is a co-branded secured credit card issued against a Fixed Deposit (FD). This card is best suited for individuals who are new to credit or have limited credit history and may otherwise face difficulties to qualify for feature-rich travel credit cards.
highlights: 6 BluChips if you pay with your IDFC FIRST IndiGo Credit Card
8 BluChips as an IndiGo BluChip member benefit
4 BluChips as a bonus for booking through the IndiGo app or website
insurance_cover: Benefit from trip cancellation coverage that renews annually for added travel security
get_this_card_if: You have never had a credit card before or have a low/no credit score that makes it difficult for you to qualify for unsecured card
You frequently travel with IndiGo Airlines and would like to earn value-back in the form of BluChips
You want additional travel benefits like zero forex mark-up and trip cancellation cover
You want to build or repair your credit score while earning benefits on travel

faqs.q: What is the minimum fixed deposit required to get this card?
faqs.a: Rs. 1 Lakh is the minimum fixed deposit required to get IDFC FIRST Dual Credit Card Against FD.

faqs.q: Is there any annual fee on this card?
faqs.a: Yes. You will be charged Rs. 4,999 + applicable taxes from 2nd year onwards on this card. For the first year there is no annual or joining fee.

faqs.q: How is IndiGo IDFC FIRST Dual Credit Card Against FD different from its regular variant IndiGo IDFC FIRST Dual Credit Cards?
faqs.a: The main difference between both the card lies in issued and joining fee. The FD-backed variant is a secured credit card which is issued against a fixed deposit of Rs. 1 Lakh or more and comes with zero joining fee. Whereas the regular variant is an unsecured credit card that comes with a joining fee of Rs. 4,999. However, all other features and benefits remain the same.

faqs.q: Will my fixed deposit continue to earn interest after it is placed for the card?
faqs.a: Yes. The fixed deposit will continue to earn interest. It simply serves as a security deposit for the credit card.

faqs.q: My fixed deposit is of Rs. 1 Lakh, will I get a credit limit of Rs. 1 Lakh only on my card?
faqs.a: Typically, limit on a secured credit card is set as a percentage of the fixed deposit. However, the exact limit is decided by the bank at the time of card issuance.
